messages:
alice.eng: Heads-up — we started seeing a steady 5xx increase at ~10:05 UTC after the staged deploy. Customer reports timeouts + a billing anomaly (unexpected token burn). Canary traffic is 10%. @irene-ops can you take a look? :warning:

deploy-bot: deploy service/redwood-gateway@canary-20260317 started by sam-ml at 10:02 UTC

bob-sre: grabbing metrics. 502/504s spike from gateway/front-proxy to auth-service. Latency up on requests that include longer Authorization headers.

sam-ml: tagging in — this canary enabled `edge-header-sanitizer-v2` and `prefetch_shedder` flags as part of the rollout. I pushed the config last night.

irene-ops: observed same. Logs show auth-service returning 400/502 after header size becomes ~>32 bytes. Gateway logs show header truncated to 32 bytes by sanitizer. Example log: `WARN header_sanitizer: truncated header authorization len=135 -> 32`

cs-jordan: we have a customer on support ticket #CS-1124 complaining about failed requests and unexpected charges. They linked to a failed inference job that retried and billed tokens.

alice.eng: timeline: canary rolled at 10:02, error spike by 10:05, support ticket at 10:08. We need rollback if config broke auth.

bob-sre: quick repro (internal):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(python -c 'print("A"*120)')" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"test"}'
```
Response shows 502 + header truncation in gateway logs.

irene-ops: I recommend toggling `edge-header-sanitizer-v2` off for the canary selector and triggering a canary rollback to stable. Rolling flag first to avoid full rollback if possible.

sam-ml: agreed. Steps I'm taking: 1) flip `edge-header-sanitizer-v2=false` on canary selector, 2) monitor 5xx, 3) if still bad, `kubectl rollout undo` on gateway deployment.

irene-ops: copying commands: 
```
# flip flag in config service
redwoodctl config set selector=canary edge-header-sanitizer-v2=false --env=prod
# verify
redwoodctl config get selector=canary | grep sanitizer
```

alice.eng: also notify billing to pause automated token reconciliations for affected customer IDs until we confirm retries. @cs-jordan can you coordinate?

cs-jordan: on it — paused auto-bill and reached out to the customer. Will open a follow-up for refund if needed.

bob-sre: after the flag flip (10:12) 5xx rate dropped ~80% within 2 minutes. Telemetry: gateway 5xx -> 12/min from 60/min.

sam-ml: rollback not required for now. Keeping canary off for sanitizer. I'll prepare a hotfix that avoids header truncation and add unit test for header length pass-through.

irene-ops: action items: sam to submit patch + rollout plan, ops to watch the next 30m window and be ready to rollback, cs to track impacted customers + refunds, alice to file postmortem.

alice.eng: filing incident report now and scheduling brief postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: config update applied (edge-header-sanitizer-v2=false) by sam-ml at 10:12 UTC — validation OK

bob-sre: last check at 10:16 UTC: error-rate trending down, auth-service healthy, billing anomaly window captured (10:02-10:12).

alice.eng: closing thread for now — will reopen if symptoms reappear. Keep notes in the incident doc.
